name: PercCheck
dataset: USDA SSURGO soil survey, percolation and drainage class per parcel
heroHeadline: Will my county's soil pass a septic perc test?
heroLede: USDA's own soil survey already rates how well the ground percolates for a septic absorption field, county by county, for all 3,144 US counties. This shows you that rating, free, before you pay for a site-specific perc test.
